payload.title: Run Python and C projects with supplied stdin
payload.description:
As the student, I want to supply input up front and run Python or C projects, so that I can test against sample data.

Feature: Run Python and C projects
  Scenario: Python reads stdin
    Given a Python project that doubles an integer read from stdin
    And the stdin is 21
    When the project is run
    Then the output is 42

  Scenario: C reads stdin
    Given a C project that sums two integers from stdin
    And the stdin is 3 4
    When the project is run
    Then the output is 7
